from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,json,re
p=Path("audits/2026-10-11-br-sd-1g-adopt-6eae3597/agents/proof")
review=p/"REVIEW.md"
links=[]
for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)",review.read_text()):
 if target.startswith("http"): continue
 rel=target.split("#",1)[0]
 if rel: links.append({"target":target,"exists":(p/rel).exists()})
assert all(x["exists"] for x in links), links
ast.parse((p/"fetch_primary.py").read_text())
inputs=json.loads((p/"INPUT_HASHES.json").read_text())
assert all(x["equal_to_fixed_base_blob"] for x in inputs["inputs"])
for x in inputs["inputs"]:
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(x["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x["sha256"]
fetch=json.loads((p/"FETCH.json").read_text())
assert fetch["equals_original_frozen"]
assert hashlib.sha256((p/"gallai.live.pdf").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==fetch["sha256"]
print(json.dumps({"review_sha256":hashlib.sha256(review.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"local_links":links,"input_hashes_hold":True,"fetch_hash_holds":True,"syntax_valid":True,"blocking_findings":0},indent=2))
